purpose: A reproducible catalogue of official hydrological observations and independent flood-event evidence candidates for AI_RESILIENCE. Downloading a dataset does not establish its suitability as a model label.

download_policy.reuse_note: Check each provider's current licence and terms before redistribution. NWDP resources have been described as Other (Open), but preserve attribution and re-check terms.

downloadable_sources.title: Rainfall (Telemetry - Hourly), Kerala Surface Water Department, 2021-2025
downloadable_sources.publisher: Kerala Surface Water Department, catalogued by National Water Data Portal / National Water Informatics Centre
downloadable_sources.license: NWDP metadata lists resource licence as Other (Open); verify current terms
downloadable_sources.role: Candidate observation input for historical rainfall summaries and later time-aligned analysis
limitations: Station metadata, timestamp convention/time zone, coordinate reference and positional accuracy must be checked.
Does not provide independently verified flood/no-flood outcome labels.
Do not combine stations or aggregate duplicate timestamps until conflicts are investigated.

downloadable_sources.title: River Water Level (Telemetry - Hourly), Kerala Surface Water Department, 2021-2025
downloadable_sources.publisher: Kerala Surface Water Department, catalogued by National Water Data Portal / National Water Informatics Centre
downloadable_sources.license: NWDP metadata lists resource licence as Other (Open); verify current terms
downloadable_sources.role: Candidate hydrological observation; only use station-specific levels after reference/datum checks
limitations: Water level is not the same as flood depth and can only be interpreted against a verified station datum and official thresholds.
Known local-copy concerns include inconsistent river/basin descriptors and unresolved gauge-reference metadata.
Does not provide independently verified flood/no-flood outcome labels.

downloadable_sources.title: River Water Level (Manual - Hourly), Kerala Surface Water Department, 2021-2025
downloadable_sources.publisher: Kerala Surface Water Department, catalogued by National Water Data Portal / National Water Informatics Centre
downloadable_sources.license: NWDP metadata lists resource licence as Other (Open); verify current terms
downloadable_sources.role: Candidate hydrological observation; station/datum review required
limitations: Manual observations may be irregular; preserve original timestamps and missingness.
Known local-copy concerns include inconsistent river/basin descriptors and unresolved gauge-reference metadata.
Does not provide independently verified flood/no-flood outcome labels.

event_evidence_candidates.title: Crowd-sourced Flood 2018 inundation-depth evidence
event_evidence_candidates.publisher: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority / Kerala State Emergency Operations Centre and research partners
event_evidence_candidates.reported_coverage: KSDMA states approximately 13,000 points were collected across Kerala after the 2018 flood.
event_evidence_candidates.role: Potential spatial validation evidence if raw point records, coordinates, timestamps, measurement definitions and reuse terms can be obtained.
event_evidence_candidates.status: Public page and map are discoverable; a machine-readable downloadable point file has not yet been verified.
limitations: A map image alone is not a machine-readable label table.
Points need coordinate/reference, depth, collection method, location precision and quality checks before use.

event_evidence_candidates.title: Ernakulam flood hazard probability and exposure maps based on historical data
event_evidence_candidates.role: Independent context layer for exposure and historic hazard, not event-by-hour labels.
event_evidence_candidates.status: Official PDF linked from KSDMA hazard maps page.
limitations: PDF/map values must be extracted and georeferenced carefully before spatial analysis.
Return-period/hazard probability is not the observed outcome of a specific hour or station.

event_evidence_candidates.title: Flood return probability rasters (10, 25, 50, 100, 200 and 500 years)
event_evidence_candidates.publisher: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority; page cites UNEP, UN GRID, CIMA Italy and additional flood return-probability assessment work
event_evidence_candidates.role: Potential GIS hazard layer after CRS, legend, resolution, scenario and licence checks.
event_evidence_candidates.status: Official page links historical-data raster ZIP resources.
limitations: Not a substitute for time-stamped observed flood outcomes.
Must not be converted into a station-hour classifier target.

event_evidence_candidates.title: India Flood Inventory-Impacts (IFI-Impacts), 1967-2023
event_evidence_candidates.publisher: HydroSense Lab, IIT Delhi; hosted on Zenodo
event_evidence_candidates.role: Candidate independent district/event inventory for cross-checking event dates and reported impacts.
event_evidence_candidates.status: Open dataset record found; exact files, schema, district scope, licence and target granularity must be inspected before use.
limitations: National/district-level event records do not automatically label station-level hourly flood outcomes.
Check the dataset version, DOI, licence, missingness and event definition before joining.

event_evidence_candidates.title: Kerala Floods and Landslides: Post-Disaster Needs Assessment
event_evidence_candidates.publisher: Government of Kerala / Kerala State Disaster Management Authority
event_evidence_candidates.role: Official historical event context and impact documentation.
limitations: Narrative and district summaries need explicit spatial/time interpretation; do not turn broad statements into station-time labels.

evaluation_gate.reason: Hydrological measurements and hazard maps are not equivalent to independently verified, time-aligned flood outcomes.
minimum_requirements: Validate timestamps, units, station identifiers, coordinates, missingness and duplicate/conflicting keys.
Resolve gauge datum/reference and official station-specific thresholds before interpreting river levels.
Obtain independently verified outcomes with spatial unit, time interval, target definition and evidence source.
Set prediction issue time and horizon before selecting features; exclude information unavailable at issue time.
Use chronological/event-grouped holdout and compare against a simple baseline.
Report event and sample counts, class balance, confusion matrix, precision, recall and F1; do not claim model skill if data are insufficient.
